subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

SUCCEED
solution:
The correct answer is '**Lose**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Succeed**' is '**Lose**'.
 
• **Succeed**: to manage to achieve what you want; to do well. (अभीष्‍ट को प्राप्‍त कर लेना; सफल होना; कामयाब होना)
 
 
• Example: Our plan **succeeded**.
 
 
 
• **Lose**: fail to win (a game or contest). [जीतने में असफल होना]
 
 
• *Example: I’ve **lost** my purse. I can’t find it anywhere.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Lose.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Win**: to be the best, first, or strongest in a race, game, competition, etc. [जीतना, विजय प्राप्‍त करना (दौड़, खेल, प्रतियोगिता आदि में)]
 
• **Achieve**: to complete something by hard work and skill. (किसी कार्य को मेहनत व कौशल द्वारा संपन्‍न करना)
 
• **Gain**: to obtain or win something, especially something that you need or want. (वस्‍तु तक पहुँचना या प्राप्‍त करना, विशेषतः अपेक्षित या अभीष्‍ट वस्‍तु; पाना)
